summary: Phase 1 continues making incremental progress. Added 3 new lemmas to NFGameBridge.lean (now 739 lines, all sorry-free): discrete_eval_lift_equiv, discrete_eval_muSig_equiv, and existential_transfer_from_nf. The last is a KEY general theorem showing NF agreement at depth d+1 implies existential transfer at depth d. Deep mathematical analysis confirms the game-based approach is genuinely necessary -- the sorry in nf_2var_existential_transfer involves a circular dependency (n-var NF at depth d+1 <-> (n+1)-var transfer at depth d) that only the EF game breaks. The Composition.lean ghr93_strategy_compose theorem (sorry-free) provides the composition tool for building the game. Build clean (1684 jobs).
